zh: Playback/CSS v1.2.1 修复顶栏 HUD 头像与回放身份错位，并修复真人从观察者加入队伍时的回放 bot 槽位交还异常。GUI 保持 v1.2.0，无需更新。
en: Playback/CSS v1.2.1 fixes top-HUD avatars becoming detached from replay identities and fixes replay bot slot handoff when a human joins a team from spectator. The GUI remains at v1.2.0 and does not need an update.
